  "summary": "This four-page archival bundle centers on a typed express telegram from Minoo Masani in Bombay to Prof. Ranga in New Delhi, dated 17 August 1964. Masani asks Ranga to notify recipients of the cancellation of the Kisan Sammelan meeting scheduled for 6 September in New Delhi, before Ranga’s departure. The telegram is addressed to two Swatantra Party locations in New Delhi and is filed with related correspondence from Gujarat.",
  "The accompanying material includes a handwritten English letter dated 13 August 1964 from Dahyabhai Prabhubhai Patel, secretary of the Khedut Sangh in Bardoli, Surat District. The letter concerns Gujarat’s representation on an Action Committee for satyagraha against the Seventeenth Amendment, with proposed representatives and an additional invitation to Dharamsinh Patel of Junagadh, secretary of the Saurashtra Khedut Samaj. Pages 3 and 4 contain Gujarati correspondence and an inland-letter envelope; their precise contents are not fully legible in the rendered images.",
